title: Broncos place OL Nick Gargiulo on the PUP and LB Jordan Turner on the NFI

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos place OL Nick Gargiulo on the PUP and LB Jordan Turner on the NFI
sources.description: The Denver Broncos announced on Sunday that they have placed offensive lineman Nick Gargiulo on the Physically Unable to Perform list (PUP) and linebacker Jordan Turner on the Actice/Non-Football Injury list (NFI). Gargiulo, a former 7th-round pick, missed all of the 2025 season after suffering a season-ending knee injury during the preseason and now will […]
